# orca-plugin.json fields

<!-- Generated by config/scripts/generate-plugin-authoring-skill-references.mjs. Do not edit. -->

`Since` is the first Orca release that reads a field: raise `engines.orca` to the newest one you use. Orca refuses unknown keys at every level. File paths are relative to the plugin root; `..` segments and Windows device names such as `CON` are refused.

## Top level

- `$schema` (string, since 1.4.245): JSON Schema URL for editor completion. Ignored by Orca.
- `manifestVersion` (2, required, since 1.4.245): Manifest format. Use 2 for new plugins.
- `execution` ("data" | "declarative" | "sandboxed-ui" | "trusted-worker", required, since 1.4.245): Most authority the plugin needs, least first: `data` (themes, syntaxes, translations), `declarative` (commands, shortcuts, recipes), `sandboxed-ui` (panels), `trusted-worker` (`main` and events). Contributions beyond it fail validation.
- `id` (string, required, since 1.4.160): Plugin id, kebab-case. The install identity is `<publisher>.<id>`, where Orca derives the publisher from the repository owner. The reserved names `constructor` and `prototype` are refused.
- `publisher` (string, since 1.4.160): Deprecated: leave it out. Orca derives the publisher from where the plugin comes from, the way a Go module is named by its repository path: the repository owner for the official and community catalogs and for Git URL installs (`acme` for `github.com/acme/gleam-syntax`), and `local` for a folder. A value here is ignored for catalog and Git installs. Leaving it out needs `engines.orca` of at least `>=1.4.246`, because older Orca requires it; if you keep it for older Orca, it must equal the repository owner. Reserved owners (`stablyai`, `official`, `anthropic`, `openai`, `github` and any starting `orca`) and ids starting `orca-` install only from Orca's official catalog.
- `name` (string, required, since 1.4.160): Display name.
- `version` (string, required, since 1.4.160): Plugin version, semver.
- `description` (string, since 1.4.160): One or two sentences shown in the plugin list.
- `author` (object, since 1.4.160): Who maintains the plugin.
- `author.name` (string, required, since 1.4.160): Author or organization name.
- `author.url` (string, since 1.4.160): Author homepage.
- `repository` (string, since 1.4.160): Source repository URL.
- `license` (string, since 1.4.245): SPDX license expression.
- `homepage` (string, since 1.4.245): Project homepage, https only.
- `icon` (string, since 1.4.160): Square image shown beside the plugin name. PNG, WEBP, static, at least 128×128, square, at most 256 KB.
- `engines` (object, required, since 1.4.160): Host versions this plugin supports. Older hosts refuse to load it.
- `engines.orca` (string, required, since 1.4.160): Oldest Orca release this plugin runs on, as `>=x.y.z`. Raise it to the newest "Since" of any field you use; a format 2 manifest needs at least `>=1.4.245`, because older Orca cannot read format 2.
- `main` (string, since 1.4.160): Node entry run in an out-of-process plugin worker: a `.js`/`.mjs` module, or a `.ts`/`.mts` module that Orca transpiles when it loads (needs `engines.orca` `>=1.4.246`). Requires the `trusted-worker` execution profile, and is required by it, by `contributes.events` and by any command without an `action`.
- `capabilities` (Capability[], since 1.4.160): Host APIs the plugin asks the user to grant. At most 32.
- `cover` (object, since 1.4.245): Wide image at the top of the plugin page.
- `cover.path` (string, required, since 1.4.245): Cover image shown on the plugin page, 16:10 recommended (1600×1000). PNG, JPEG, WEBP, static, at least 800×500, at most 1024 KB.
- `cover.alt` (string, required, since 1.4.245): What the image shows, for screen readers. Required.
- `screenshots` (Screenshot[], since 1.4.245): Screenshots for the plugin page, at most 6. All images together may be at most 8 MB.
- `pluginApi` (1, since 1.4.160): Major version of the plugin host API this plugin targets. Optional (defaults to 1), and refused on `data` and `declarative` plugins, which never call it.

## Contribution points (`contributes`)

- `panels` (PanelContribution[], since 1.4.160): Sidebar panels. At most 64.
- `commands` (CommandContribution[], since 1.4.160): Command palette entries. At most 256.
- `events` (EventContribution[], since 1.4.160): Events delivered to the plugin worker. At most 4.
- `languagePacks` (LanguagePackContribution[], since 1.4.160): Interface translations. At most 16.
- `keybindings` (KeybindingContribution[], since 1.4.160): Keyboard shortcuts for contributed commands. At most 256.
- `vmRecipes` (VmRecipeContribution[], since 1.4.160): Virtual machine environment recipes. At most 64.
- `themes` (ThemeContribution[], since 1.4.245): App color themes. At most 64.
- `terminalThemes` (ThemeContribution[], since 1.4.245): Terminal ANSI palettes. At most 64.
- `iconThemes` (ThemeContribution[], since 1.4.245): File icon themes. At most 32.
- `syntaxes` (SyntaxContribution[], since 1.4.245): Syntax highlighting for editor languages. At most 16.
- `customEditors` (CustomEditorContribution[], since 1.4.245): Editors that open files of given types in the editor tab. At most 16.
- `newFiles` (NewFileContribution[], since 1.4.245): Untitled files the user can create from the + menu and the command palette. At most 16.
- `settings` (SettingContribution[], since 1.4.246): Settings Orca shows under the plugin in Settings; code reads them with `settings.get` (`settings:own`). At most 64.

Reserved (must stay empty arrays): `agentHarnesses`, `skills`, `mcpServers`, `hooks`, `taskSources`, `connections`, `statusBarItems`, `sidebarCards`.

## PanelContribution

A sidebar panel. Requires the `sandboxed-ui` execution profile or higher.

- `id` (string, required, since 1.4.160): Panel id, unique among this plugin's panels. The reserved names `constructor` and `prototype` are refused.
- `title` (string, required, since 1.4.160): Title shown on the panel tab and its tooltip.
- `icon` (one of activity, bar-chart-3, bell, blocks, book, bot, bug, calendar, cloud, code, database, file-text, flag, folder, gauge, globe, hammer, layers, lightbulb, package, plug, puzzle, rocket, star, terminal, wrench, zap, add, remove, delete, edit, refresh, search, settings, check, close, info, warning, error, open-external, copy, download, upload, play, pause, stop, more, expand, collapse, next, filter, branch, file, agent, link, since 1.4.160): Icon shown in the right-sidebar activity bar. Defaults to `plug`.
- `entry` (string, required, since 1.4.160): What the panel runs: an HTML page for `ui: "html"`, a `.js`/`.mjs` module for `ui: "components"`. Either may instead be a `.ts`/`.tsx`/`.mts`/`.jsx` file, which Orca transpiles when it loads (needs `engines.orca` `>=1.4.246`; an `html` panel then gets a generated page around it). It is trusted code: install panels you trust.
- `ui` ("html" | "components", since 1.4.246): How the panel draws its UI. `html` (default) shows `entry` as a web page in an isolated frame; `components` runs `entry` as a hidden module and Orca draws the component tree it returns with its own controls.

## CommandContribution

A command palette entry. Requires the `declarative` execution profile or higher.

- `id` (string, required, since 1.4.160): Command id, unique among this plugin's commands. Dotted namespaces are allowed.
- `title` (string, required, since 1.4.160): Title shown in the command palette.
- `when` ("global" | "workspace", since 1.4.160): Where the command is available. `workspace` hides it when no workspace is active. Defaults to `global`.
- `action` (one of worktree.history.back, worktree.history.forward, sidebar.left.toggle, sidebar.sleepingWorkspaces.toggle, floatingWorkspace.maximize, tab.rename, workspace.rename, workspace.openBoard, view.tasks, sidebar.right.toggle, sidebar.explorer.toggle, sidebar.search.toggle, sidebar.sourceControl.toggle, sidebar.checks.toggle, sidebar.ports.toggle, since 1.4.160): Built-in Orca action this command runs. A command with an action is declarative and never starts the plugin worker; one without needs `main`.

## EventContribution

An event subscription. Requires `main`, the `trusted-worker` execution profile and the capability of the event's domain: `workspace:read` for workspace events, `agent:read` for agent events.

- `on` ("workspace.created" | "workspace.removed" | "agent.status.changed" | "workspace.changed", required, since 1.4.160): Event delivered to the plugin worker.

## LanguagePackContribution

An interface translation.

- `locale` (string, required, since 1.4.160): BCP 47 locale the pack translates Orca into. Each locale appears once, ignoring case.
- `path` (string, required, since 1.4.160): JSON file of translated interface strings.
- `displayName` (string, since 1.4.245): Native-language name for the Settings picker. Omitted packs show `{locale} — {pluginKey}`.

## KeybindingContribution

A keyboard shortcut for a command.

- `command` (string, required, since 1.4.160): Id of a command this plugin contributes in `contributes.commands`.
- `key` (string, required, since 1.4.160): Key chord Orca recognizes, such as `Mod+Shift+K`. `Mod` is Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere. Each chord may be bound once on every platform.
- `when` ("global" | "workspace", since 1.4.160): Where the shortcut is active; must match its command's `when`.

## VmRecipeContribution

A virtual machine environment recipe.

- `path` (string, required, since 1.4.160): JSON environment recipe file, listed once.

## ThemeContribution

A titled theme file.

- `id` (string, required, since 1.4.245): Theme id, unique within its family in this plugin. The reserved names `constructor` and `prototype` are refused.
- `title` (string, required, since 1.4.245): Name shown in the theme picker.
- `path` (string, required, since 1.4.245): JSON theme file, at most 16 KiB.

## SyntaxContribution

Syntax highlighting for one language.

- `id` (string, required, since 1.4.245): Language id, unique among this plugin's syntaxes. The reserved names `constructor` and `prototype` are refused.
- `title` (string, required, since 1.4.245): Language name shown in the editor.
- `scopeName` (string, required, since 1.4.245): The grammar's root TextMate scope, unique among this plugin's syntaxes.
- `path` (string, required, since 1.4.245): TextMate grammar JSON file.
- `configuration` (string, since 1.4.245): Language configuration JSON file: comments, brackets and auto-closing pairs.
- `extensions` (string[], since 1.4.245): File-name suffixes, with the dot, this language opens, ignoring case. A longer suffix such as `.excalidraw.json` wins over a shorter one, and a file named only the suffix never matches. At most 32.
- `filenames` (string[], since 1.4.245): Exact file names this language opens, ignoring case; a name beats any extension. Names must be portable: no path separators, `.`, `..` or characters Windows forbids. At most 32.

## CustomEditorContribution

An editor for the listed files, shown in the editor tab beside Source. It must list at least one extension or file name. Requires the `sandboxed-ui` execution profile or higher.

- `id` (string, required, since 1.4.245): Editor id, unique among this plugin's custom editors. The reserved names `constructor` and `prototype` are refused.
- `title` (string, required, since 1.4.245): Name shown in the editor's view toggle beside Source, and on the tab of a file it opens.
- `icon` (string, since 1.4.245): Square image shown on the tab of a file this editor opens. Defaults to the plugin icon. PNG, WEBP, static, at least 128×128, square, at most 256 KB.
- `extensions` (string[], since 1.4.245): File-name suffixes, with the dot, this editor opens, ignoring case. A longer suffix such as `.excalidraw.json` wins over a shorter one, and a file named only the suffix never matches. At most 32.
- `filenames` (string[], since 1.4.245): Exact file names this editor opens, ignoring case; a name beats any extension. Names must be portable: no path separators, `.`, `..` or characters Windows forbids. At most 32.
- `entry` (string, required, since 1.4.245): HTML file rendered inside an editor frame, like a panel, or a `.ts`/`.tsx` module that Orca transpiles and loads in a generated page (needs `engines.orca` `>=1.4.246`). It receives the open document and posts edits back; it never gets a file path or file system. It is trusted code: install editors you trust.
- `priority` ("default" | "option", since 1.4.245): `default` (the default) opens matching files in this editor; `option` only offers it in the view toggle, so files open in Source. Files Orca opens itself (such as `.json`, `.ts`, `.md`, `.csv`, `.yaml`, lockfiles and `.env` files) always behave as `option`.
- `contentKind` ("text" | "bytes", since 1.4.245): `text` (the default) sends the file as text and accepts full-text edits. `bytes` sends the file's raw bytes, for binary formats such as spreadsheets, and accepts full-byte edits.

## NewFileContribution

A kind of untitled file the user can create from the tab bar + menu or the command palette, in the active workspace.

- `id` (string, required, since 1.4.245): New-file id, unique among this plugin's new files. The reserved names `constructor` and `prototype` are refused.
- `title` (string, required, since 1.4.245): Menu item shown in the tab bar + menu and the command palette.
- `extension` (string, required, since 1.4.245): Suffix, with the dot, of the untitled file it creates. The file opens in whatever editor takes that suffix, such as a custom editor from this plugin.
- `template` (string, since 1.4.245): UTF-8 file copied into the new file, at most 256 KB. Without one the file starts empty.
- `icon` (string, since 1.4.245): Square image shown beside the menu item. Defaults to the plugin icon. PNG, WEBP, static, at least 128×128, square, at most 256 KB.

## SettingContribution

A setting shown under the plugin in Settings. Requires the `settings:own` capability, which is also how code reads it.

- `key` (string, required, since 1.4.246): Key code reads and writes, unique in this plugin.
- `title` (string, required, since 1.4.246): Label shown in Settings.
- `description` (string, since 1.4.246): Help text shown under the label.
- `type` ("string" | "number" | "integer" | "boolean", required, since 1.4.246): JSON Schema type of the value.
- `default` (string | number | boolean, since 1.4.246): Value read while the person has not set one.
- `enum` (string | number[], since 1.4.246): Allowed values; Settings shows a picker.
- `enumLabels` (string[], since 1.4.246): Picker labels, one per `enum` value.
- `minimum` (number, since 1.4.246): Numbers: smallest value.
- `maximum` (number, since 1.4.246): Numbers: largest value.
- `maxLength` (integer, since 1.4.246): Strings: most characters.
- `multiline` (boolean, since 1.4.246): Strings: a multi-line text box.
- `placeholder` (string, since 1.4.246): Strings and numbers: hint shown while empty.

## Capability

A host API the plugin may call once the user consents.

- `kind` ("workspace:read" | "agent:read" | "terminal:send" | "notifications:show" | "storage:own" | "secrets:own" | "settings:own", required, since 1.4.160): Capability granted on user consent.

## Screenshot

One screenshot of the plugin in use.

- `path` (string, required, since 1.4.245): Screenshot, 16:10 recommended (up to 2560×1600). PNG, JPEG, WEBP, static, at least 1280×800, at most 1536 KB.
- `alt` (string, required, since 1.4.245): What the image shows, for screen readers. Required.
- `caption` (string, since 1.4.245): Short caption under the screenshot.
- `theme` ("light" | "dark", since 1.4.245): Show this screenshot only with a light or dark Orca theme.
